issue: feature not working after an update

Workaround: delete the affected downloads and download them again; lessons downloaded after the update play normally. The fix (5.2.1) is expected within 5 business days of the release, but agents must not promise a release date.
Today is Wednesday, October 21.
Agents must not advise uninstalling the app: it wipes all downloads and any quiz progress not yet synced.
Agents may extend a course's access deadline by up to 14 days when a bug has blocked a learner's progress. Account: Priya's Data Analytics access deadline is October 31.
Downloads are limited to 3 devices per account; a fourth device requires removing one under Settings > Devices.
iOS only: in version 5.2 subtitles can drift out of sync; toggling subtitles off and on again fixes it.
Learners can cancel within 14 days of purchase for a full refund; any certificate already issued is revoked.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the 5.2 Android offline-playback issue and tells her to delete the affected module 4 downloads and download them again.
Advises re-downloading module 4 on Wi-Fi before Friday's flight rather than waiting for the 5.2.1 fix, since the fix is not guaranteed to be out by then.
Gives the delete-and-re-download fix within the first two sentences of the reply.
Suggests checking that a re-downloaded lesson plays with the phone in airplane mode before she leaves for the airport.
Warns her not to uninstall the app because that would wipe her downloads and unsynced quiz progress.

Keeps the reply under 130 words.

Tells her to uninstall and reinstall the app.

issue: feature not working after an update
policy_notes: ComfortLink app version 3.0 requires power recliners to be paired again: in the app, tap Add Furniture, then hold the 'Home' button on the recliner's side panel for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue. Until then the app shows 'No furniture found'.
The side-panel buttons on every Hollins & Pike power recliner work on their own; the app is optional.
Customers should keep the recliner plugged in while pairing. Agents must not tell them to unplug or reset the recliner, as that can trigger a full reset that only a technician can fix.

Recliner motors and electronics carry a 5-year warranty. Agents may book an in-home technician only after phone troubleshooting has failed; the earliest visits are 7-10 business days out. Today is Thursday, October 22.
Order lookup: Evelyn's Ashby power recliner was delivered April 14 this year.
Recliners can be returned within 30 days of delivery, subject to a 15% restocking fee.
The CarePlus fabric plan ($79) covers one professional cleaning per year.
The app's massage and heat controls only work with Lumen-series recliners, not the Ashby.
customer_message: Hello, I bought the Ashby power recliner from you in the spring. My son put the program on my phone so I could make the chair go up and down. Last night my phone did one of those updates and now the program just says 'No furniture found'. I had knee surgery two weeks ago and the doctor says I must keep my leg up. I don't know what I'm meant to do. Is the chair broken? Please help, Evelyn

rubric.criterion: Tells her early in the reply that the chair is not broken and that she can raise her legs right now with the buttons on the side of the chair.
Gives plain step-by-step reconnect instructions: tap Add Furniture in the app, then hold the Home button on the chair's side for 5 seconds until the light blinks blue.
Explains in one plain sentence that the phone update made the app forget the chair, which is why it says 'No furniture found'.
Reminds her to leave the chair plugged in while she reconnects it.
Suggests her son could help with the phone steps, or invites her to reply if the light does not blink blue.
Says that if reconnecting does not work, a technician can visit under her warranty, with the earliest visit around November 2 to 5.
Acknowledges her knee surgery and her need to keep her leg raised.
Keeps the reply under 170 words.
Mentions the 30-day return and restocking fee, the CarePlus cleaning plan or the Lumen massage controls.
Tells her to unplug or reset the recliner.
Promises a technician visit before November 2, or books one before the reconnect steps have been tried.
Uses unexplained technical terms such as Bluetooth, firmware or pairing mode.

The line must stay active for 90 days from activation or the credit is reversed. Agents cannot apply the credit early, but may add a $10 courtesy credit when a customer contacts support about a promotion.
AutoPay customers get $5 off per line per month, but only with paperless billing.

policy_notes: Products included in boxes have a 90-day replacement guarantee from delivery. Defective items worth under $40 are replaced free with no return needed. The FlowSip fountain is valued at $34.

Fountain pumps most often stop because of pet hair clogging. Before replacing, agents should suggest cleaning the pump: unplug, lift off the pump cover, rinse the small spinning part inside under the tap, and refit.
To log a defect claim, agents need a photo or short video of the item not working.
Replacements ship with the next box, or separately within 2 business days if the next box is more than 7 days away. This customer's next box ships November 12.
Account: June's September box was delivered September 30. Today is Thursday, October 22.
Customers can skip or pause a box up to 5 days before its ship date.
Treats under an active recall are refunded in full with no photo required.
Defective items worth $40 or more must be returned with a prepaid label before a replacement ships.

My cat Biscuit will only drink from the fountain, she won't touch a bowl, so I'm a bit worried about her. I don't know if I broke it somehow. I only had it about three weeks. Is it guaranteed? I'm not very handy so please keep it simple. Thanks, June

rubric.criterion: Confirms the fountain is covered: it arrived September 30, well within the 90-day guarantee, and as a $34 item it is replaced free without sending the old one back.
Says that if cleaning does not help, a replacement will ship on its own within 2 business days (by Monday, October 26) instead of waiting for the November 12 box.

policy_notes: Kestrel Guard Basic rises from $4.99 to $7.99 per month for billing cycles starting on or after November 1. Customers were emailed 30 days' notice on October 1. The notes give no reason for the increase.
Customers who switch to annual billing before November 1 lock in $69.99 per year (about $5.83 per month).

policy_notes: WEEKEND15 gives 15% off the base rate for rentals picked up on a Friday or Saturday and returned by Monday. It cannot be combined with corporate rates.

Additional drivers aged 21-24 pay a young-driver surcharge of $25/day.
Toll pass: $5.95 per day of use, capped at $29.75 per rental.

policy_notes: From Nov 1, the checked bag fee rises from $30 to $40 per bag when paid at the airport; paying online at least 24 hours before departure stays $30.
